data_description.poll_interval: How often the hub is asked for the state of every shade. Each request makes the hub serialise its whole state document; 2 is the upstream default, 10 or more is kinder to the hub.
data_description.signal_poll_interval: How often ONE shade is asked, over the hub's serial port, for a live radio signal reading (shades take turns). The hub's own cached value does not refresh on its own on Pulse Pro hubs. While this is on, a shade whose check got no reply shows an unknown signal rather than an old number, and a Missed signal checks sensor counts those misses.

refresh_signal.name: Refresh signal
refresh_signal.description: Asks each targeted shade for a live radio signal reading right now, one shade at a time, the same query the live signal sweep sends. The shade's Signal sensor updates when it answers. Target a shade's cover or its Refresh signal button. Never moves a shade.
